title: Fast two-language website with a catalogue of work
lead: Home page, a catalogue and a page for each item in two languages, readable on a phone.

hero.caption: Project catalog: each card shows status, summary and next step.
hero.alt: Project catalog: each card shows status, summary and next step.

problem: Make it clear within a minute what the author does and what has been done. Pages should open fast, read well on a phone and in two languages, and a new item should be addable without rebuilding the site.
built: Home: headline, three main projects, a how-it-works section, a resume and contacts.
A catalogue and a page for each project: task, what was done, screenshots.
The English version has no Russian words; language versions and a sitemap are set up for search engines.
Menu and pages work on a phone from 320 px wide; accessibility is checked automatically on every page.
A new item is added with one data file and goes straight into the checks.

shots.caption: A project page: description, version, download button and a four-part outline.
shots.alt: A project page: description, version, download button and a four-part outline.

steps: Content lives in data files and texts.
The site is built into plain fast pages in two languages.
Every page goes through automatic checks, including accessibility.
A new project is one new data file.
offer: A site in 1-2 languages: a home page and a catalogue built from your texts and images.
Design in this style or to your references; a phone check.
Site files ready to put on your hosting.
not_included: Domain and hosting (you pay for them); A request form, a shop, a personal account; Writing the texts, if you have none.
